text: おにいさん　きょうは　じょうたいいじょうに　ついて　せつめい　しちゃうよ！
note: Hosts of Japanese children's TV programmes are called おにいさん ("big brother") or おねえさん, and refer to themselves that way on air; the speaker is styled as one. The English game named him the POKé DUDE instead.
claim: Presenters on Japanese children's TV shows such as NHK's Okaasan to Issho are known as うたのおにいさん / うたのおねえさん ("song big brother / big sister").

check.quote: He is the 11th generation Uta no onīsan of NHK's programme Okaasan to Issho.
